rationale: Bugs 1-2 sit on the verifier/delivery seam: buildVerifiedCompletion in src/completion/verified-completion.ts treats empty verifier output as 'no answer' and returns the i18n last-resort stub (neutralFallback/noopFallback, hence the locale dictionaries), and resolveFinalText in src/llm-orchestrator-send.ts returns verified.text unconditionally, discarding already-generated model text. The same verifier seam is invoked from src/deferred-prompts/proactive-llm-helpers.ts (finalizeAndLog) and wired up in src/llm-orchestrator-support.ts (buildTurnVerifier + sendLlmResponse call), so the semantics change (empty = skip verification, deliver model text, record ok/empty/error outcome) propagates through both call sites; the trace-outcome requirement extends the LlmTrace record in src/debug/llm-trace-collector.ts (in-memory buffer, no DB). Bug 3 is the missing chunking on the 4096-limit platforms: sendFormattedReply in src/chat/telegram/reply-helpers.ts and the send path in src/chat/kontur-talk/reply-helpers.ts post one unsplit message that the platform rejects outright, while reply-fn-builder.ts owns the formatted wiring/lastReplyTarget snapshot that multi-message sends must keep coherent; Discord's format-chunking.ts/sendChunksSequentially is the in-repo reference pattern, not an edit target, and Mattermost (16383 limit) is outside the reproduced failures. Cross-module: completion -> orchestrator send -> chat adapters -> debug trace -> i18n. Provider surface: edits land inside existing chat adapter reply helpers (telegram, kontur-talk), though no adapter interface or config changes. Novelty: all fixes land in existing modules with existing test suites (tests/llm-orchestrator-send.test.ts, tests/completion/*, tests/chat/telegram|kontur-talk/reply-helpers.test.ts, tests/debug/llm-trace-collector.test.ts); no new top-level subsystem, no schema migration, no credentials handling.
